description: End-to-end composition proof of the open pre-payment decision chain. From raw identity, authority, and policy inputs, each content-addressed reference is recomputed independently (RFC 8785 JCS + SHA-256, no package import), shown to equal the published output of its own lite conformance set, and shown to be exactly the input the Spend Guardrail decision binds. The final guardrail_ref is then recomputed from the three composed references plus the verdict and matches the published spend_guardrail_lite_v1 reference byte-for-byte, for both ALLOW and DENY. No new vectors, no new hashing primitive: every asserted value is an existing published expected output. The chain: passport_ref (identity) + mandate_ref (authority) + policy_bound_ref (policy) -> guardrail_ref (decision).

policy_bound_ref.construction: policy_ref = sha256: + SHA-256(JCS(policy)); policy_bound_ref = sha256: + SHA-256(JCS({policy_ref, subject_ref}))

decision.construction: guardrail_ref = sha256: + SHA-256(JCS({agent_ref, mandate_ref, policy_bound_ref, verdict}))

note: Recomputing any input field diverges the affected reference and every reference downstream of it, so a decision made for one agent/authority/policy cannot be silently re-attributed to another. The composition introduces no new construction; it proves the four independently published constructions chain into one recomputable decision.
